consensus_summary: Primary consensus identifies rock as God (and Christ in Christian reading) as unshakable foundation, refuge, protector, and source of salvation/stability, with Matthew 16:18 as the main contested secondary referent (Peter/confession/Christ) and complementary motifs like stumbling-stone or struck rock.
book_summary: Jesus Christ as covenant Head and bedrock foundation, refuge, and source beneath His house and kingdom, on whom His people stand (opposite: sand).
consensus_core_identification: God/Christ as firm foundation, refuge, and salvation
book_core_identification: Jesus Christ as bedrock foundation, refuge, and source for His people/house/kingdom
boundary_disagreement: None material; book simply specifies the NT Christological focus already present in consensus primary readings and does not engage or re-draw the Matthew 16:18 alternatives.
rationale: Minimum cores are identical in referent and force (divine/Christic foundation-refuge). Book’s covenant-Head and house/kingdom phrasing plus opposite ‘sand’ are consistent elaborations of the same Matt 7 / 1 Cor 10 imagery already central to consensus; no replacement of the primary identification occurs and secondary debates are simply left unaddressed.
strongest_objection: Book’s exclusive focus on Christ could be read as narrowing away from OT ‘God is the Rock’ texts that consensus treats as primary, yet the printed citations themselves (esp. 1 Cor 10:4) already perform that Christological identification.
